 Export posts from the old CMS › Notes › Export plan › What went wrong on the first attempt
 • Posts before 2014 use <pre> blocks with hard tabs, which the converter turned into a single long
   line.
 • Three posts embed a video through an iframe. Those stay as raw HTML:
   ◦ the Vimeo ones still play
   ◦ the old Flash one is replaced by a link to the transcript
 • The image download hit a rate limit around post 400, so it now sleeps between requests and
   resumes from where it stopped.

 │ Keep the dump for a year. The one time an old post turned out to be missing, the dump was the
 │ only copy left, and nobody remembered which table it came from.

 The redirect table comes from this export, so finish it first. The hosting notes
 (https://example.com/hosting-notes) say which headers the new host needs for the permanent
 redirects, and the rewrite rule that broke last time was /archives/(\d+)/(.*)$.

 One image path is longer than any screen and has to wrap on its own:
